subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp land this narrow all-unmentioned `suppressTyping` mitigation, or wait for the broader visible-delivery typing boundary before changing automatic group typing semantics?
rationale: Both paths can address false WhatsApp typing indicators, but tests cannot decide the user-visible tradeoff where proactive visible unmentioned replies lose their typing flash.

options.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to the admission-derived conversation and mention fields while preserving the authorized-command carve-out.

options.title: Prefer the visible-delivery boundary
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical path only after its conflicts and plugin/API compatibility risks are resolved.

options.title: Keep current behavior for now
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned group turns with their current typing behavior until live repro evidence or a stronger UX decision raises the priority.

recommendation.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to the admission-derived conversation and mention fields while preserving the authorized-command carve-out.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery typing PR and has recent merged history in WhatsApp inbound dispatch.
